filter_results_by_domain: filter search results by domain and resolved IP addresses using an allow or block list
validate_search_result_model: validate a search result with link, title, and snippet fields using the SearchResult Pydantic model
resolve_hostname_ips: resolve a hostname to its IPv4 and IPv6 addresses using the resolve_hostname utility
check_string_allowed: check if a domain or hostname string is allowed against an allow/block filter list
safe_validate_urls: validate a sequence of URLs checking protocol, filter list, and private IP resolution
